title: ICEYE Wikipedia — fourth Polish ICEYE + Portuguese satellites launched on Falcon 9 CAS500-2 rideshare (May 3)
snippet: Fourth Polish ICEYE satellite launched on May 3, 2026 on Falcon 9 CAS500-2 rideshare; second Portuguese satellite (first owned by Portuguese Air Force) launched same mission.
tag_reason: 신규 — 5/3 보고서는 CAS500-2 자체 발사를 등록했으나 ICEYE 폴란드 4호기·포르투갈 2호기 라이드쉐어 탑재 정보 미보도. ICEYE constellation 확장 신호
